The PR wraps TUI editor submit bang-line, command, and message handlers so returned promise rejections are caught and logged, with a proof script and regression tests.

PR surface: Source +10, Tests +90, Other +72. Total +172 across 3 files.

target.title: fix(tui): suppress unhandled rejection from editor submit handlers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`createEditorSubmitHandler` calls `params.handleBangLine`, `params.handleCommand`, and `params.sendMessage` as fire-and-forget `void` expressions. Because those params are typed `Promise<void> | void`, an async rejection would become an unhandled rejection and could crash the TUI process.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added a small `suppressHandlerRejection` helper that only attaches a `.catch` when the handler actually returns a promise. When it rejects, a generic stderr diagnostic is written and the error is swallowed, matching the existing agent-session abort fallback pattern.

## User Impact

The TUI is more resilient to rare async failures in command/message handlers; users see a brief diagnostic instead of a process crash.

## Evidence

Terminal proof (after fix):

```bash
node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/proof/tui-submit-rejection-catch.mts
```

Output:

```
=== Proof: tui-submit rejecting handler catch ===

Triggering bang-line, command, and send-message handlers that all reject...

All rejecting handlers were caught; no unhandled rejections.

PASS: tui-submit suppresses async handler rejections.
```

Regression test:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/tui/tui-submit.test.ts
```

All 4 tests pass.
